- Maps requested areas → segments per entity, tracking every area handled by *any* entity in `handled_areas`.
- Collects each entity's clean call into `entity_data` and dispatches them via `service_helper.async_handle_entity_calls` **before** the error check — so mapped entities always get their clean call even when some areas are unmapped.
- After processing, raises `ServiceValidationError(translation_key="areas_not_mapped", translation_placeholders={"areas": ", ".join(sorted(unhandled_areas))})` if any requested area wasn't mapped by any entity.
